$comment: GENERATED by wp/tests/wp-integration/mcp_abilities.sh from the abilities a running site registers (Pro on). Do not edit: WRITE_REGISTRY=1 regenerates it, and the harness fails when this file differs from the site.

mcp.auth: a WordPress application password (HTTP) or --user (WP-CLI); the user needs the capability each ability names
mcp.switch: Settings: Allow AI agents (MCP), on by default

rest.run: /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/abilities/<name>/run  (GET with ?input= for read-only abilities, POST {"input": {...}} otherwise)

abilities.name: zinn-chat/answer-ticket
abilities.label: Answer a ticket
abilities.description: Replies to the customer by email (text), or adds an internal note (note: true); status optionally changes the ticket's status.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/ask-assistant
abilities.label: Ask the assistant
abilities.description: Asks the site's AI assistant a question and returns its answer with every source it found.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

question.description: The question, as a visitor would ask it (up to 2,000 characters).

language.description: Language code of the answer, e.g. de; the site language when omitted.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/bulk-update-tickets
abilities.label: Change many tickets at once (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes the status, priority or assignee of up to 100 tickets (ids). Each ticket goes through the same checks as changing it on its own; the result lists each one.
abilities.capability: zinn_chat_answer

abilities.name: zinn-chat/chat-to-ticket
abilities.label: Turn a chat into a ticket
abilities.description: Opens a ticket from a chat so it can be answered by email (needs the visitor's email address).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/close-chat
abilities.label: Close a chat
abilities.description: Ends a chat; the visitor can still ask for the transcript.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/create-ticket
abilities.label: Open a ticket
abilities.description: Opens a ticket on a customer's behalf (their email, a subject and the first message).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

email.description: The customer's email address; replies go there.

body.description: The first message of the ticket.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/delete-canned-reply
abilities.label: Delete a saved reply (Pro)
abilities.description: Deletes a saved reply.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/delete-ticket
abilities.label: Delete a ticket
abilities.description: Deletes a ticket and its conversation for good (managers only).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/draft-kb-article
abilities.label: Draft a help article from a ticket (Pro)
abilities.description: Writes a draft knowledge-base article from a solved ticket; it stays a draft until a person publishes it.
abilities.capability: edit_posts (the REST route's own check)

ticket.description: ID of the solved ticket the article is drafted from.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/draft-kb-from-gaps
abilities.label: Draft help articles for unanswered questions (Pro)
abilities.description: Writes draft knowledge-base articles answering the chosen questions (ids); they stay drafts.
abilities.capability: edit_posts (the REST route's own check)

ids.description: IDs of the knowledge gaps to cover in one draft.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/fill-canned-reply
abilities.label: Fill in a saved reply (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns a saved reply's text with its placeholders filled for one chat or ticket.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/get-chat
abilities.label: Read a chat
abilities.description: Returns one chat's messages and visitor details (after: only messages newer than this id).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/get-overview
abilities.label: Read the support overview
abilities.description: Returns how many tickets are in each status and how many chats are waiting for a person (and their unread messages), and whether the chat, the assistant and tickets are switched on.
abilities.capability: zinn_chat_answer

abilities.name: zinn-chat/get-settings
abilities.label: Read the chat settings
abilities.description: Returns every chat setting: the widget, the assistant, people and opening hours, tickets and email, the site index, privacy and spam.
abilities.capability: zinn_chat_manage

abilities.name: zinn-chat/get-stats
abilities.label: Read support statistics (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns chat and ticket numbers, response times and ratings for the last N days (days).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

days.description: How many days back the report covers; 30 when omitted.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/get-ticket
abilities.label: Read a ticket
abilities.description: Returns one ticket with its whole conversation, status, priority and assignee.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/hand-chat-to-assistant
abilities.label: Hand a chat back to the assistant
abilities.description: Returns a chat to the AI assistant, which answers the visitor from the site's content.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/list-canned-replies
abilities.label: List saved replies (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the saved replies agents can insert, with their shortcuts.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/list-chats
abilities.label: List live chats
abilities.description: Lists the chats waiting, in progress and recently closed, with who is handling each.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

view.description: Which chats: active (default), with the AI assistant, closed, or all.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/list-indexed-content
abilities.label: List what the assistant knows
abilities.description: Lists the content the assistant answers from, with its index status, a page at a time.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

search.description: Words in the title or URL.

status.description: Only items in this state; every state when omitted.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/list-kb-gaps
abilities.label: List unanswered questions (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the questions visitors asked that the knowledge base could not answer.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

status.description: Which gaps: open (default), drafted, answered, ignored or all.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/list-tickets
abilities.label: List tickets
abilities.description: Lists support tickets, filtered by status or a search, a page at a time.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

status.description: Which tickets: active (open and pending, the default), one status, or all.

search.description: Words in the subject, the customer's name or email.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/reembed-content
abilities.label: Rebuild the assistant's search index
abilities.description: Rebuilds the search vectors for one item (item_id) or everything (all: true) (managers only).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

all.description: True: every indexed item; otherwise only item_id.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/reindex-content
abilities.label: Re-read content into the assistant
abilities.description: Re-reads one item (item_id) or everything (all: true) into the assistant's index (managers only).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

all.description: True: the whole site; otherwise only item_id.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/reply-chat
abilities.label: Reply in a chat
abilities.description: Sends a message to the visitor (text), or adds an internal note only agents see (note: true).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/save-canned-reply
abilities.label: Save a saved reply (Pro)
abilities.description: Creates or changes a saved reply (title, shortcut, body, department; id to change one).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

id.description: ID of the saved reply to change; a new one when omitted.

shortcut.description: Short code agents type to insert it (letters, digits, - and _).

department.description: Department it belongs to; every department when empty.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/save-kb-article
abilities.label: Write a help article (Pro)
abilities.description: Creates a knowledge-base article, or changes one (id): title, content, excerpt, categories and status (draft, or publish when you may publish).
abilities.capability: edit_posts

abilities.name: zinn-chat/search-kb
abilities.label: Search the knowledge base (Pro)
abilities.description: Finds help articles to link in a reply (q: the search).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

q.description: Words to search the help articles for.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/set-conversation-details
abilities.label: Set a conversation's department and tags (Pro)
abilities.description: Sets the department and tags of a chat or ticket (kind: chat or ticket; id).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

kind.description: Whether id is a ticket (default) or a chat.

id.description: ID of the ticket or chat.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/set-kb-gap-status
abilities.label: Mark unanswered questions (Pro)
abilities.description: Marks unanswered questions as open, planned or dismissed (ids, status).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

status.description: The new state of the gaps.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/set-presence
abilities.label: Set your availability
abilities.description: Marks the signed-in agent available or away for new chats (away: true or false).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

away.description: True marks the agent away; False (default) available.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/suggest-reply
abilities.label: Draft a reply with AI (Pro)
abilities.description: Drafts a reply to a chat or ticket from the site's content; nothing is sent.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

kind.description: Whether id is a ticket (default) or a chat.

id.description: ID of the ticket or chat.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/summarise-conversation
abilities.label: Summarise a conversation with AI (Pro)
abilities.description: Summarises a chat or ticket in a few lines.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

kind.description: Whether id is a ticket (default) or a chat.

id.description: ID of the ticket or chat.

abilities.name: zinn-chat/take-chat
abilities.label: Take a chat
abilities.description: Assigns a waiting chat to the signed-in agent, so the visitor talks to a person.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: zinn-chat/update-settings
abilities.label: Change the chat settings
abilities.description: Changes the settings you send (settings: key to value) and keeps the rest. Each value is checked exactly as on the settings screen; get-settings lists the keys.
abilities.capability: zinn_chat_manage

abilities.name: zinn-chat/update-ticket
abilities.label: Change a ticket
abilities.description: Changes a ticket's status, priority or assignee.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check
